title: Tracking shot, epic action camera, '@ Reference Image' person is sprinting…
content: Tracking shot, epic action camera, '@ Reference Image' person is sprinting through an obstacle course, avoiding objects. The camera orbits around him and goes into slow motion as he dives to the finish line, then full speed as he passes the finish line, continuous shot.

es.content:
---
Toma de seguimiento, cámara épica de acción, la persona de '@ Reference Image' está corriendo a toda velocidad por un circuito de obstáculos, esquivando objetos. La cámara orbita a su alrededor y entra en cámara lenta mientras se lanza hacia la línea de meta, luego a toda velocidad cuando cruza la línea de meta, toma continua.

--- CONTINUACIÓN DEL HILO ---
[Hilo 1] Aquí está el prompt base que utilicé:

Tracking shot, epic action camera, '@ Reference Image' person is sprinting through an obstacle course, avoiding objects. The camera orbits around him and goes into slow motion as he dives to the finish line, then full speed as he passes the finish line, continuous shot.
---

fr.content:
---
Plan-séquence, caméra d'action épique, la personne '@ Reference Image' court à toute allure à travers un parcours d'obstacles, évitant les objets. La caméra tourne autour de lui et passe au ralenti alors qu'il plonge vers la ligne d'arrivée, puis reprend à pleine vitesse lorsqu'il franchit la ligne d'arrivée, prise continue.

--- CONTINUATION DU FIL ---
[Fil 1] Voici le prompt de base que j'ai utilisé :

Tracking shot, epic action camera, '@ Reference Image' person is sprinting through an obstacle course, avoiding objects. The camera orbits around him and goes into slow motion as he dives to the finish line, then full speed as he passes the finish line, continuous shot.
---

ja.content:
---
トラッキングショット、エピックアクションカメラ、'@ Reference Image' の人物が障害物コースを全力で走り抜け、物体を避けています。カメラは彼の周りを回り、ゴールラインに飛び込むときにスローモーションになり、ゴールラインを通過するときにフルスピードに戻る、連続ショット。

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---

---

ko.content:
---
트래킹 샷, 에픽 액션 카메라, '@ Reference Image' 인물이 장애물 코스를 전력 질주하며 물체를 피합니다. 카메라는 그를 중심으로 회전하고, 그가 결승선을 향해 다이빙할 때 슬로우 모션으로 전환되며, 결승선을 통과할 때는 풀 스피드로 돌아오는 연속 샷입니다.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---

pt.content:
---
Travelling, câmera épica de ação, a pessoa da '@ Reference Image' está correndo por um percurso de obstáculos, evitando objetos. A câmera orbita ao redor dele e entra em câmera lenta enquanto ele mergulha para a linha de chegada, depois volta à velocidade total ao passar pela linha de chegada, tomada contínua.

zh.content:
跟踪镜头，史诗般的动作摄像机，'@ Reference Image' 人物在障碍赛道上冲刺，避开物体。摄像机环绕他旋转，当他冲向终点线时进入慢动作，然后在他越过终点线时恢复全速，连续镜头。
